description:
YTSeg: A Benchmark for Audio Chaptering and Video Transcript Segmentation
	

We present YTSeg, a topically and structurally diverse benchmark for the audio chaptering and transcript segmentation task based on YouTube videos. The dataset comprises 19,299 videos from 393 channels, amounting to 6,533 content hours. The topics are wide-ranging, covering domains such as science, lifestyle, politics, health, economy, and technology.
